metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · The Super Mario Bros. Movie
metas.description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are warped to the magical Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario must team up with Princess Peach, Toad, and Donkey Kong to save Luigi from the evil Bowser.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Inside Out 2
metas.description: A sequel that features Riley entering puberty and experiencing brand new, more complex emotions as a result. As Riley tries to adapt to her teenage years, her old emotions try to adapt to the possibility of being replaced.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2022 · Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: When Puss in Boots discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll and he has burned through eight of his nine lives, he launches an epic journey to restore them by finding the mythical Last Wish.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Elemental
metas.description: Follow Ember and Wade, in a city where fire, water, earth and air live together.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Guillermo del Toro's Pinocchio
metas.description: A father's wish magically brings a wooden boy to life in Italy, giving him a chance to care for the child.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Flow
metas.description: Cat is a solitary animal, but as its home is devastated by a great flood, he finds refuge on a boat populated by various species, and will have to team up with them despite their differences.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · The Boy and the Heron
metas.description: In the wake of his mother's death and his father's remarriage, a headstrong boy ventures into a dreamlike world shared by the living and the dead in search of his missing stepmother.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: A world-renowned K-Pop girl group balance their lives in the spotlight with their secret identities as demon hunters.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Toy Story 5

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
metas.description: The Turtle brothers work to earn the love of New York City while facing down an army of mutants.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · Transformers One
metas.description: The untold origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron, better known as sworn enemies, but who once were friends bonded like brothers who changed the fate of Cybertron forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Suzume
metas.description: A modern action adventure road story where a 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps a mysterious young man close doors from the other side that are releasing disasters all over in Japan.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Sea Beast
metas.description: When a young girl stows away on the ship of a legendary sea monster hunter, they launch an epic journey into uncharted waters - and make history to boot.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Nimona
metas.description: When a knight in a futuristic medieval world is framed for a crime he didn't commit, the only one who can help him prove his innocence is Nimona -- a mischievous teen who happens to be a shapeshifting creature he's sworn to destroy.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Predator: Killer of Killers
metas.description: Three of the fiercest warriors in human history become prey to the ultimate killer of killers.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Leo

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Swapped

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Bob's Burgers Movie

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba - To the Swordsmith Village

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2024 · Solo Leveling: ReAwakening
metas.description: Over a decade after 'gates' connecting worlds appeared, awakening 'hunters' with superpowers, weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo encounters a double dungeon and accepts a mysterious quest, becoming the only one able to level up, changing ...

metas.description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, a boy who was born with no magic, aims to become the "Wizard King" to overcome adversity, prove his power, and keep his oath with his friends.
